auth_tokens_invite_check.name: auth_tokens_invite_check
auth_tokens_invite_check.value: "auth_tokens"."kind" <> 'invite' OR ("auth_tokens"."role" IS NOT NULL AND "auth_tokens"."target_user_id" IS NULL)

auth_tokens_password_reset_check.name: auth_tokens_password_reset_check
auth_tokens_password_reset_check.value: "auth_tokens"."kind" <> 'password_reset' OR ("auth_tokens"."target_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "auth_tokens"."role" IS NULL AND "auth_tokens"."email" IS NULL)

auth_tokens_used_by_check.name: auth_tokens_used_by_check
auth_tokens_used_by_check.value: "auth_tokens"."used_by_user_id" IS NULL OR "auth_tokens"."used_at" IS NOT NULL

card_covers_dimensions_check.name: card_covers_dimensions_check
card_covers_dimensions_check.value: ("card_covers"."width" IS NULL OR "card_covers"."width" BETWEEN 1 AND 20000) AND ("card_covers"."height" IS NULL OR "card_covers"."height" BETWEEN 1 AND 20000)

cards_completion_check.name: cards_completion_check
cards_completion_check.value: ("cards"."status" = 'completed' AND "cards"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cards"."completed_by" IS NOT NULL) OR ("cards"."status" = 'open' AND "cards"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "cards"."completed_by" IS NULL)

checklist_items_checked_check.name: checklist_items_checked_check
checklist_items_checked_check.value: ("checklist_items"."is_checked" AND "checklist_items"."checked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "checklist_items"."checked_at" IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT "checklist_items"."is_checked" AND "checklist_items"."checked_by" IS NULL AND "checklist_items"."checked_at" IS NULL)

users_credentials_present_check.name: users_credentials_present_check
users_credentials_present_check.value: "users"."anonymized_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("users"."email" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL)

users_anonymized_check.name: users_anonymized_check
users_anonymized_check.value: "users"."anonymized_at" IS NULL OR ("users"."email" IS NULL AND "users"."password_hash" IS NULL AND "users"."status" = 'deactivated')
